intro: Flat terrain, dry air and no vegetation make the desert the best VHF/UHF propagation you will experience with a handheld. From a ridge in Death Valley or the South Rim you can work distances that seem impossible. This is also the most interesting military airspace in the world — the Nevada Test and Training Range sits just north of Las Vegas and it talks on AM in 225–380 MHz.
introz: 地形平坦、空气干燥、没有植被，沙漠是手台能体验到的最好的 VHF/UHF 传播环境。在死谷或大峡谷南缘的山脊上，通联距离会好到不可思议。这里也拥有全球最有意思的军事空域——内华达试验与训练靶场就在拉斯维加斯以北，其通话位于 225–380 MHz 的 AM 波段。

stations.d: Extremely high volume with unusual peaks around conventions and fight weekends. Listen from the airport's aircraft viewing area on Sunset Road.
stations.dz: 流量极高，展会和拳赛周末会出现异常高峰。可在 Sunset 路的观机点收听。

stations.z: 哈里·里德机场自动通播
stations.d: Useful for one thing above all in summer: hearing the actual temperature and density altitude read aloud.
stations.dz: 夏天最有用的一点：能听到实测温度和密度高度被念出来。

stations.d: Base for most Grand Canyon air-tour operators.
stations.dz: 大多数大峡谷观光飞行公司的基地。

stations.d: Gateway for canyon air tours. The Special Flight Rules Area over the canyon has its own dedicated corridors and frequencies — a genuinely unique piece of airspace.
stations.dz: 峡谷观光飞行的门户。峡谷上空的特别飞行规则区有专属走廊和频率，是一片非常独特的空域。

stations.z: 死谷 / Furnace Creek 公共频率
stations.d: A strip at 210 feet below sea level. Also listen for military low-level traffic through Rainbow Canyon nearby.
stations.dz: 海平面以下 210 英尺的简易跑道。附近 Rainbow Canyon 还能听到军机低空穿越。

stations.z: 洛杉矶区域管制（沙漠扇区）

stations.d: Set the VX-6 to AM and scan 225–380 MHz anywhere north of Las Vegas or along US-95 toward Tonopah. Red Flag exercises put dozens of aircraft on the air at once with callsigns and range control chatter. Nothing else in civilian radio sounds like it.
stations.dz: 把 VX-6 设为 AM，在拉斯维加斯以北或沿 95 号公路往 Tonopah 方向扫 225–380 MHz。Red Flag 演习期间几十架飞机同时通话，能听到呼号和靶场管制。民用无线电里没有任何东西与之相似。

stations.d: The unmarked white 737s that fly employees from a private terminal at Las Vegas to the Nevada Test and Training Range. They use discrete frequencies and rotate them. Hunting for them is half the fun.
stations.dz: 从拉斯维加斯私人航站楼把员工送往内华达试验与训练靶场的无标志白色 737。它们使用专用频率并会轮换，找它们本身就是一半乐趣。

stations.d: In summer this is not optional. Flash-flood warnings for slot canyons come out here first.
stations.dz: 夏天这不是可选项。狭缝峡谷的暴洪警报最先从这里发出。

stations.z: NOAA 弗拉格斯塔夫 / 大峡谷
大峡谷国家公园局作业
stations.d: Ranger, trail patrol and helicopter rescue traffic. The inner-canyon rescue calls are sobering and are the best possible argument for carrying more water. Scan 162–174 MHz to find current channels.
stations.dz: 护林员、步道巡逻和直升机救援通话。峡谷内部的救援呼叫听着令人清醒，也是多带水的最佳理由。扫 162–174 MHz 找当前频率。

stations.d: Shuttle operations, Angels Landing incidents and canyoneering rescues.
stations.dz: 摆渡车调度、天使降临步道事故和峡谷探险救援。

stations.d: Desert line-of-sight is extraordinary. From Dante's View, Keys View or the South Rim a handheld reaches genuinely absurd distances.
stations.dz: 沙漠里的视距传播极为惊人。在 Dante's View、Keys View 或大峡谷南缘，手台的覆盖距离荒谬得离谱。

stations.d: Machines on Potosi Mountain and Angel Peak cover the valley and a long way out into the desert.
stations.dz: Potosi 山和 Angel Peak 上的中继覆盖整个谷地并延伸到沙漠深处。

stations.d: Sparse county sheriff coverage across the desert means mutual-aid channels matter more here.
stations.dz: 沙漠地区县警覆盖稀疏，互助频道在这里格外重要。

stations.z: MURS · 度假区与旅游作业
stations.d: Jeep tours, canyoneering guides and river outfitters. Also check FRS channels.
stations.dz: 越野团、峡谷探险向导和漂流公司常用。也可查 FRS 频道。

stations.d: Translators carry it a long way out of Las Vegas into the surrounding desert.
stations.dz: 通过转播台从拉斯维加斯一路覆盖到周边沙漠。

stations.z: KUNV 内华达大学拉斯维加斯分校

stations.d: Long-running community station in West Las Vegas.
stations.dz: 西拉斯维加斯的老牌社区电台。

stations.d: Zion, Grand Canyon and Death Valley all run low-power AM loops near entrances. Between 530 and 1710 kHz — watch for roadside signs.
stations.dz: 锡安、大峡谷和死谷都在入口附近有小功率中波循环播报，频率在 530–1710 kHz 之间，注意路边指示牌。

stations.z: KMZQ · 中波 · 新闻与谈话
KXNT · 中波 · 新闻与谈话
KWWN · 中波 · 新闻与谈话
KENO · 中波 · 新闻与谈话

stations.by: Educational Radio Foundation Of East Texas, Inc.

stations.d: Excellent reception here. The dry desert night is about as good as HF listening gets in the continental US.
stations.dz: 这里接收极佳。干燥的沙漠夜晚，是美国本土短波收听的最佳环境之一。

stations.d: A desert playa with 360 degrees of clear horizon is the single best place to catch a full satellite pass.
stations.dz: 四周地平线全无遮挡的沙漠干湖床，是完整接收一次卫星过顶的最佳地点。
